title: Other UFO-nuclear witnesses

tellings.quote: I'm not the only one only witness to these incidents involving UFOs and nuclear weapons. There are many many out there, including Dave Chandel,

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer who says UFOs interfered with nuclear missiles, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he is not the only witness to such events. He says there are many others, naming Dave Chandel and Walter Feel. If true, the link between UFOs and nuclear weapons would rest on many people, not just one.
